note: Levers that lower the funding to raise. Each lever is a set of input changes on top of the loaded plan; the Funding page applies them in this order and shows what each one takes off. Prudence settings (prepayment reserve, 25% buffer) are deliberately not levers.

levers.label: Health-tourism operator + university hospital in
levers.detail: International Plus with Atlas University Hospital: office, back office, authorisations, hotel rates, hospital day and physicians at partner rates. Paid in shares (0% revenue share).

levers.label: Physician network in
levers.detail: US Camp physician network: 60% of new clients by referral (35% alone), lead conversion 14% (10% alone). Paid in shares.

levers.label: 90% of the package paid at enrolment
levers.detail: Instead of 70% now and 30% around month six. Premium programs of this kind are usually paid in full in advance.

levers.label: Founding-cohort discount 5%
levers.detail: Instead of 15%. The pilot cohort keeps a smaller discount; feedback and case data are still asked for.

levers.label: ATRON platform fee waived in the pilot year
levers.detail: The $3k/month base fee is not charged in year 1 and the $40k set-up balance due in month 13 is converted to equity. Per-client platform cost is unchanged.

levers.label: Lean pilot-year team
levers.detail: Founder-led general manager at half cost in year 1; operations lead, client advisors, care coordinators and concierges at 50% of the pilot year (75% now). Full team from year 2.

levers.label: Lean pilot-year spending
levers.detail: Brand and website set-up $20k (from $40k), recruitment $6k (from $12k), team travel and events $20k/yr (from $40k), fixed content $1.5k/month (from $3k).

levers.label: Set-up in two months, pilot cohorts in months 3 and 6
levers.detail: Set-up is finished in two months instead of three, so the founding cohort starts in month 3 instead of month 4; the second cohort follows in month 6.
